Build and supply chain#

This page states WELD's build and supply chain practices, one per heading, each with the rule and the tag that shows whether the stack holds it today.

W30: Support only PHP versions that are not end of life#

Practice: composer.json requires php: ^8.3 with config.platform.php 8.3.0. Tests run on 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5. Laravel 13 needs 8.3 or newer.

Stack: Checked. composer.json:18 requires php: ^8.3, composer.json:134 sets config.platform.php to 8.3.0, and the CI matrix runs on 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5 (.gitlab-ci.yml:9 and .github/workflows/ci.yml:18).

W31: Keep dev tools inside the PHP floor#

Practice: Pest 5 requires PHP ^8.4. On a ^8.3 floor use Pest 4 or PHPUnit and cap the constraint.

Stack: Checked. WELD adopted Pest 4 on 2026-11-03: composer.json requires pestphp/pest ^4 (Pest 5 needs PHP ^8.4), and the CI matrix starts at 8.3 (.gitlab-ci.yml:9), so composer install runs on 8.3 and fails if a dev tool requires 8.4 or newer. The PHPUnit class tests still run unchanged, under Pest, and new tests are written in Pest.

W32: Pinstripe owns style and static analysis#

Practice: Use Pinstripe's Pint preset, PHPStan level 8 through Larastan, ESLint (flat config) and Prettier. No local overrides without a recorded reason.

Stack: Checked, for the PHP side. waynestate/pinstripe ^0.4 is a dev dependency (composer.json:43), and phpstan.neon:10 includes its phpstan/laravel.neon, so level 8, the ignore rules and the banned calls (SQL joined from strings among them) come from the package; WELD's code passes with no new ignore and no baseline. composer.json:60 runs pint --test, composer.json:63 runs phpstan analyse, and both are in the ci script (composer.json:68-77), which CI runs. pint.json is Pinstripe's pint/laravel.json plus two recorded excludes, Squire's deploy/ kit and bin/docs-site.php, since Pint cannot extend a config file; tests/Unit/PinstripeWiringTest.php fails on any other drift in either file. The JS side runs in CI too, on WELD's own config until @waynestate/pinstripe 0.3.0 is on npm: the frontend job (.gitlab-ci.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml) runs npm run lint (eslint.config.js, flat config) and npm run format:check (.prettierrc).

W33: Pin shared CI components to a commit#

Practice: Preflight components are referenced by commit SHA or a fixed tag, not a moving branch.

Stack: Checked. .gitlab-ci.yml pins every Preflight component to the 0.9.0 release tag (@0.9.0 at .gitlab-ci.yml:7, :15, :18, :26, :35, :45, :49, :56, :80; published tags in the stack never move), and .github/workflows/ci.yml:16 calls Preflight 0.9.0's reusable workflow at its release commit (fb73b538f3980292119b5b306ff64383d760a214). PROCTOR's preflight-pinned check, run by the proctor-root job (composer proctor), warns on an include without a full release tag or a commit SHA.
